随时打开五篇免费指南

你可以用这份指南区分修订、批注和可反复使用的模板。
和同事改同一份手册时，你保留修订记录；定稿后，再把通用结构做成模板。

faq: Word 技能测试以哪个版本为准？
本题本以 Windows 桌面版 Microsoft 365 Word 为准。Mac、网页版或移动端的菜单和操作可能不同。
要打开 Word 或上传自己的文档吗？
无需打开 Word 或上传文档。只需在浏览器回答题目，不会替你编辑文件、连接收件人数据或发送邮件。
25 道题怎么计分？
每题答对计 1、答错计 0。五个主题各 5 道，分项 0–5，总正确数 0–25。答齐才显示本次结果。
可以免费查看全部答案和解析吗？
可以。完整作答后，25 道题的选择、正确选项和解析都可免费查看。五篇公开指南不用答题也能读。
有倒计时或微软认证吗？
约 12 分钟是参考用时，没有倒计时或速度加分。这份独立练习不授予微软证书，也没有就业合格线。
分享会带上分数或我的答案吗？
分享链接只指向公开练习入口，不携带答案、正确数或个人标识。没有个人 PNG。独立答题页面刷新后不会恢复未完成进度。
zh.formula: 25 道题都要作答。所选项与正确选项一致计 1，否则计 0。五个主题各 5 题，各显示 0–5 的正确数，再合计为 0–25。

en.facts: FermatMind’s Word Skills Practice Test presents 25 original scenarios about Microsoft 365 Word for Windows desktop and takes about 12 minutes. It is free without registration. The result includes your total, counts across five topics, and an explanation for each answer. Five public guides are available before or after the test. The practice runs in a browser and requires no document upload.
en.intro: A blank space will not go away, just one page needs to be landscape, or a single letter needs different names. Which Word command would you try first? Answer 25 original scenarios for Word for Microsoft 365 on Windows desktop. It takes about 12 minutes, and all results are free.
deliverables: See your total and five topic counts
The result shows how many of 25 you got right and how many of five you got right for each topic.
Compare your choice with the keyed answer. The explanation describes why that command fits the situation.
All five public guides are free to read before or after the test. You can copy the public test link without sharing answers or counts.
interpretations: The sample got all five right in each topic. Try carrying out the steps in a practice document if you want to check that they are familiar in the actual app.
The counts are 4 for formatting, 5 for styles, 2 for sections, 1 for fields, and 3 for review. To work on the lowest section first, preview a merge with a small test list.
All five counts are zero. The full answer review and guides are still available. You might begin by learning to reveal formatting marks before editing a paragraph.

paragraphs-and-formatting: Find out what created the extra space
You can use the formatting guide to tell paragraph settings apart from tabs, spaces, and direct formatting.
When a gap shows up in a draft, you turn on formatting marks before deleting anything.
styles-and-structure: Use heading styles to organize a long file
You can use the styles guide to review how headings feed navigation and an automatic table of contents.
After receiving a long report with manually bolded headings, you apply heading styles and regenerate the contents.
sections-and-tables: Change one section and keep the rest intact
You can use the sections guide to revisit section breaks, orientation changes, and repeating table headings.
To fit a wide table, you put its page in its own section and check that the surrounding pages stay in portrait.
fields-and-mail-merge: Check the fields before merging records
You can use the merge guide to see what the fields do and where each record comes from.
Before making personalized confirmation letters, you preview a few dummy records to check how the names appear.
review-and-templates: Keep revision decisions and reuse the layout
You can use the review guide to distinguish tracked changes, comments, and templates.
While sharing a draft with colleagues, you track edits. After agreement, you turn the reusable layout into a template.

faq: Which version of Microsoft Word does this test use?
The bank refers to Microsoft 365 Word for Windows desktop. Mac, web, and mobile versions can have different commands or behavior.
Do I need to open Word or upload a document?
No. This is a browser-based knowledge exercise. It does not edit files, connect to recipient lists, or send a mail merge.
How are the 25 questions scored?
Each correct answer adds one. Incorrect answers add zero. Each of five topics has five items, so topic counts run from 0 to 5 and the total runs from 0 to 25.
Can I see all answers and guides for free?
Yes. A completed test shows all 25 choices, correct answers, and explanations. The five public guides are free to read at any time.
Is it timed or a Microsoft certification?
Twelve minutes is an estimate. There is no timer, speed bonus, pass mark for employment, or Microsoft credential.
Does sharing include my score or answers?
The public test link carries no answers, counts, or ID. There is no personal PNG export. Reloading the standalone test will not restore unfinished answers.
en.formula: All 25 items require an answer. Each choice matching its answer key adds one, and other choices add zero. The five topic counts each run from 0 to 5 and add up to the total from 0 to 25.
en.boundary: FermatMind created this knowledge exercise for Word in Microsoft 365 on Windows desktop. Counts summarize choices on this bank. They do not provide population norms, proficiency levels, employment pass marks, or official Microsoft certification.
